features.note: Internal cylindrical surface candidate. This is not yet a confirmed hole. Through-hole or blind-hole classification requires additional topology analysis.
Internal cylindrical surface candidate. This is not yet a confirmed hole. Through-hole or blind-hole classification requires additional topology analysis.

hole_candidates.note: Only internal cylindrical surface candidates are detected. A cylindrical surface alone does not prove a through-hole or blind-hole.

bends.note: Bend candidates are geometric transitions. They are not confirmed manufacturing bends.

components.note: Connected mesh components do not necessarily correspond to physical assembly parts.

thickness.note: Local ray-based estimates. Results may be unreliable near edges, cavities, and complex internal geometry.

limitations: STL does not contain native CAD feature definitions.
Original STL coordinates and triangle order are preserved.
A separate topology mesh is created for adjacency analysis.
Only exactly equal vertex coordinates are welded.
No distance tolerance is used for vertex welding.
Physical units are unknown unless explicitly provided.
Legacy fields ending in mm are compatibility fields and are not guaranteed to represent millimeters.
A cylindrical surface is not automatically a hole.
Connected components are not necessarily physical parts.
Thickness estimates require a watertight mesh.
Ray-based thickness estimates may be unreliable near edges, cavities, and complex internal geometry.
Bend candidates are not confirmed manufacturing bends.
Spray accessibility and robot reachability are not analyzed here.

measurement_warnings: The selected coordinate unit defines the physical interpretation of the original STL coordinates.
Changing the coordinate unit does not rescale the original mesh vertices.
STL does not universally define a standardized physical length unit. Confirm manually selected units against the original CAD model when necessary.
